what: Plan commits a new quiet-log artifact class but does not update the security contract
scenario_or_breakage: The repo currently documents breadcrumb publication as ndjson-only and says sidecars stay session-local; after the PR, larch-quiet-*-*.log files can be committed under breadcrumbs with broader stdout/stderr content, so operators and reviewers lose the authoritative security boundary for what is durable
suggested_fix: Update SECURITY.md alongside scripts/larch-log.md to describe accepted larch-quiet-*-*.log files, root-source resolution, redaction pipeline, symlink/hardlink rejection, and which .quiet monitor sidecars still remain session-local
